newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent slides to 13-month low at $17.38.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent slides to 13-month low at $17.38.

text.p: Brent crude futures slid 40 cents a barrel to its lowest level for 13 months on Wednesday evening on selling by Wall Street funds, brokers said.
July IPE was down 10 cents at $17.38 barrel at 1832 GMT, half an hour after it had risen to touch the intra day high at $17.90. The front month was its lowest since May 1996.

Brokers said a bearish mood took hold in New York on the back of Iraqi statements that there could be less trouble than oil markets had previously anticipated for sales of Iraqi crude in the second six month phase of the U.N. oil-for-food plan.
London retreated in sympathy, fuelled by fund selling.
